source_quote: I stayed where the coils had left me, ribs screaming, the fire still ebbing out of my bones, and I watched the kneeling thing the way you watch a deal that has resolved too easily.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a self-styled prophet of the Earth Temple who has begun to blur his identity with the role, despite not being a true cleric, and has made a blood pact with a salamander to gain knowledge of the Greater Temple.
source_quote: I will die sooner," he said, and closed his hand around the salamander's.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is a tiefling who understands infernal contracts, negotiates with fire creatures, and willingly endures pain to seal an alliance with a salamander, demonstrating both pragmatism and deep personal risk.
source_quote: I will die sooner," he said, and closed his hand around the salamander.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is now a leader who has accepted the chain of command, having taken the swords of subordinates hilt-first and restructured the Fire Temple under his authority.
source_quote: I'm fairly certain I already have.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the newly ascended leader of the Earth Temple, having coerced the surrender of the Fire Temple’s commander through intimidation and the symbolic handing-over of two gold coins — a gesture that signified submission, not payment.
source_quote: I will not forget this," Zephyr told him. "Nor will I," said the commander.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr is the tiefling who pokes everything in creation with a stick, and he improperly touched the Water Temple, triggering its defensive response.
source_quote: He knocked on it. The idol began to rotate. He said he wanted to check anyway.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr names the fire cleric as the new Head Cleric.
source_quote: "Alright. You're head Cleric," I said, releasing her and brushing a cushion's worth of dust off my sleeve.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr reads a contract offered by the salamander and strikes out clauses involving soul and ownership.
source_quote: He read it through, top to bottom, and I watched his eyes stop on the clauses near the end, the ones written to take more than service. The ones that buy a piece of the signer along with his signature. He struck them out.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr shakes hands with the salamander despite the fire that will burn him.
source_quote: He took it anyway. "I will die sooner," he said, and closed his hand around the salamander's.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells Calmer, "Now we are leaders," after being called an assassin.
source_quote: "I thought you were an assassin!" "Now we are leaders," I told him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells the commander, "I will not forget this."
source_quote: "I will not forget this," Zephyr told him.

subject: Zephyr
fact: Zephyr tells the fire cleric, "You could be our subordinate, or you could leave the temple."
source_quote: "If you want to leave the temple, we'll allow you to do so. If you want to stay, you must be my subordinate."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a figure who provided Calmer with a vague cover story — 'deep undercover, sneaking around' — which was accepted by Frostbrand as a satisfying justification for its new role.
source_quote: Zinnia gave it the vague version — deep undercover, sneaking around — and it loved the idea like it had invented it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a professional spy who respects honesty and does not spare kindness when confronting deception.
source_quote: I said it flat. There was no kindness to spare and no point dressing it.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a sharp-eyed observer who has tracked Zephyr’s descent into self-deception, calling out his false identity as an Earth Temple cleric and recognizing the danger of his alliances with fire-based entities.
source_quote: You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a sharp-eyed rogue who sees through disguises and false piety, calling out Calmer’s pretense as a cleric and recognizing the strategic value of leverage in alliances.
source_quote: You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is a warrior who kills with brutal efficiency, eliminating salamanders in single strikes, and who interprets the salamander’s surrender as an opportunity to claim its treasure and enforce a new hierarchy through silent dominance.
source_quote: He picked the wounded one and went straight through it — slap, slap, slap, the whole drumroll — and it simply stopped existing.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia is the most reliable knife, but she was slow off her mark this time — the clumsiest start I have ever seen her take, and she warned against overreaching into a room not yet owned.
source_quote: Not to go too deep. To not overreach into a room I did not yet own.

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia says Calmer is not a real cleric of the Earth Temple.
source_quote: "You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tells Calmer he is going too deep in his deception.
source_quote: "I think you're going in too deep."

subject: Zinnia
fact: Zinnia tells Calmer he understands the art of spying.
source_quote: He said I understood the art of spying, that if I told him he was going too deep, he would believe me.

subject: Altar
fact: A round, broad, waist-high altar with a concave top filled with coins, gems, seashells, and a drowned fortune — the source of the temple’s power and temptation.
source_quote: And the altar: round, broad as a wagon and waist-high, its concave top a shallow basin, and in that water, gentlemen, *coins.* Gems. Seashells. A whole drowned fortune sitting there waiting.

subject: bronze bas-relief
fact: Zephyr knocks on the bronze bas-relief in the Water Temple, triggering its magic.
source_quote: He knocked on it.

subject: Bronze Sheet
fact: A bas-relief bronze sheet on the west wall depicts an underwater vista with seaweed, shells, and a hideous fish-head spewing water — it is real and triggered the temple’s defense when touched.
source_quote: He chose the bronze sheet. He wanted to see if it was real. I told him it was real.

subject: dagger
fact: The fire cleric draws a dagger when questioned by Zephyr.
source_quote: She didn't answer. She went for her dagger.

subject: fire resistance items
fact: The chest contained two potions, a ring, and a sword — all granting resistance to fire, with the sword being unnaturally cold.
source_quote: Inside: two potions that promised to turn flame aside. A ring that did the same. ... one more — a sword, cold to the touch, wrong in this room full of heat.

subject: fire temple contract
fact: The contract offered by the salamander contained clauses seeking soul ownership, which Zephyr struck out before signing with his blood.
source_quote: The moment Zephyr touched it, the script rearranged itself ... The ones that buy a piece of the signer along with his signature. He struck them out. Soul, ownership ... He cut himself and signed.

subject: fire temple treasure chest
fact: The chest contained fire-resistant items and Frostbrand, protected by a blade trap that missed Sequoia due to his speed.
source_quote: Sequoia opened the box. A blade cut the air where his throat would have been and found nothing — his hands had already moved him clear.

subject: flaming spear
fact: A salamander sets its flaming spear down on the stone.
source_quote: It set its flaming spear down on the stone.

subject: Flaming spear
fact: The flaming spear is the salamander’s weapon of fire and destruction, now deliberately laid upon the stone as a symbol of surrender and a precondition for negotiation.
source_quote: It set its flaming spear down on the stone.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand asks if any of the party are good.
source_quote: Then it asked whether any of us were good.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand coughs when lifted from the chest.
source_quote: The sword coughed. A real cough. Out loud, from a length of steel that had no throat to do it with.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a cold magical sword found in a fire pit.
source_quote: And one more — a sword, cold to the touch, wrong in this room full of heat.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a cold, sentient sword that defies its environment — burning with chill in a fire pit — and carries the memory of its imprisonment by Vorkal, seeking justice and a worthy wielder.
source_quote: It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a sentient magical sword of unnatural cold, found in a fire pit, capable of speech, and which chose Zephyr as its first target before rejecting him and remaining unclaimed, suggesting a deeper alignment or test.
source_quote: It said yes. I asked the only question that mattered. 'Are you gonna kill me if I touch you?' It seemed offended by the suggestion.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand is a sentient sword that claims to have been picked up as a trophy from Emridy Meadows and has a history of demanding recognition; it now resides in Calmer’s possession, whispering its will and affirming its bond with him.
source_quote: What's your name?" Frostbrand. "How long have you been in that box?" A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand points at Zephyr, Zinnia, Sequoia, and Calmer to judge their alignment.
source_quote: It pointed at Zephyr first. ... It looked at Zinnia. ... It looked at me. ... And then it looked at Calmer.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand says it has been in the box since Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Frostbrand
fact: Frostbrand speaks to Vorkal in the language of salamanders.
source_quote: It started talking — to Vorkal, in whatever language salamanders curse in — and the whole thing turned.

subject: frostbrand sword
fact: The cold magical sword named Frostbrand was found in a fire pit and is sentient, having been imprisoned since Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A magical sword in the box. Cold to the touch. ... It said yes. ... Frostbrand. ... Since Emridy Meadows.

subject: Frost-shield
fact: The frost-shield is Calmer’s defensive artifact that repels salamander attacks with chilling force, rendering their fire-based assaults ineffective and enabling the party to survive long enough for negotiation to occur.
source_quote: Our cleric stood wrapped in his frost-shield, the cold haze of it rolling off his plate.

subject: gold coin value
fact: Two gold pieces are handed over as a symbol of surrender, not payment.
source_quote: The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything.

subject: Infernal Contract
fact: The infernal contract is a magical parchment that rearranges its text for the reader, containing clauses that demand soul or ownership — which Zephyr nullifies with his own hand, revealing his experience with such pacts.
source_quote: He struck them out. Soul, ownership, whatever the thing was reaching for — gone, lines drawn through it in his own hand before he'd spent a drop of blood.

subject: Obsidian Edge
fact: The Obsidian Edge is the title Calmer uses to represent his absolute authority — a symbolic name tied to his self-declared supremacy over the Upper Temple, evoking sharpness, finality, and unyielding control.
source_quote: the Obsidian Edge and the Chief Cleric is myself, Calmer.

subject: ring
fact: A ring that turns flame aside is found in the chest.
source_quote: A ring that did the same.

subject: Salamander Pact
fact: The Salamander Pact is a blood-bound agreement between Zephyr and a fire entity, granting knowledge of the Greater Temple in exchange for loyalty and the promise of mutual benefit, with the cost of Zephyr’s own mortality.
source_quote: Zephyr cut himself and signed. Then he put out his hand to shake — into a creature that would burn him for the contact.

subject: scarlet robe
fact: A scarlet robe is tucked under the pillows in the Fire Temple chamber.
source_quote: A scarlet robe tucked under the pillows.

subject: Scarlet Robe
fact: The scarlet robe, once worn by the Fire Cleric as a symbol of her rank, now lies tucked under pillows — a relic of a defeated order, its color repurposed as a visual metaphor for the temple’s bloodied legacy.
source_quote: A scarlet robe tucked under the pillows.

subject: silver candlestick value
fact: The silver candlesticks flanking the Lolth altar are worth 25 gp each.
source_quote: a pair of heavy silver candlesticks worth 25 gp each

subject: Throne of the Fire Temple Commander
fact: A massive red-and-gilt wooden throne with a gold skull leering from its back, once the seat of the Fire Temple’s commander, now stands empty of its former authority and occupied only by the memory of defeat.
source_quote: A huge wooden seat, red and gilt, with a gold skull leering off the back. A throne, in other words.

subject: two gold coins
fact: The commander hands over two gold coins to Zephyr as payment for sparing his life.
source_quote: The commander handed over two gold pieces, very confused, holding them out like a man tipping the executioner.

subject: Two Gold Coins
fact: The two gold coins handed over by the Fire Commander were not ransom, but a ceremonial token of submission — a physical symbol of surrender that carried greater weight than any oath or treaty, marking the recipient as the new master.
source_quote: The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything.

subject: two potions
fact: Two potions that promise to turn flame aside are found in the chest.
source_quote: Inside: two potions that promised to turn flame aside.

subject: Alrrem
fact: Frostbrand asks where Alrrem is.
source_quote: Then it stopped and asked where Alrrem was, and who I was.

subject: Alrrem’s Death
fact: The death of Alrrem, former leader of the Fire Temple, was orchestrated by Zephyr and remains unspoken — a hidden act of vengeance that enabled the current power shift.
source_quote: Neither did I, in the end. I just made certain he found that out the hard way.

subject: Alrrem's Fate
fact: The name Alrrem is invoked as a lost figure — possibly a leader, a martyr, or a key to the temples’ collapse — whose death triggered the current war and whose memory haunts both Frostbrand and the former Fire Temple commander.
source_quote: The obsidian edge, the interlopers who killed Alrrem, destroyed my temple, massacred my forces.

subject: Calmer's self-perception
fact: Calmer believes he has earned leadership through force, but the internal justification is not fully articulated.
source_quote: I keep finding that, lately — Zephyr isn't wrong, the title fits, the chain holds, and the men keep handing me their swords hilt-first.

subject: Cover Speaking for Calmer
fact: Calmer’s insistence on being called 'the Prophet of the Earth Temple' reveals that his public persona is now speaking his inner doubts and objections — a sign his identity is collapsing under performative piety.
source_quote: The cover was speaking again, and it was getting louder.

subject: Emridy Meadows
fact: Frostbrand was taken as a trophy from Emridy Meadows.
source_quote: A very long time, it said. Since Emridy Meadows. Picked up as a trophy.

subject: Frostbrand’s True Alignment
fact: Frostbrand, a cold blade in a fire pit, has chosen to speak — and it pointed at Zephyr first, then rejected him. Its intent, its origin, and its true allegiance remain unknown, but it clearly opposes the Fire Temple’s dominance.
source_quote: It pointed at Zephyr first. Zephyr is neutral. The sword said no.

subject: Identity Crisis of Zephyr
fact: Zephyr’s transformation from a pragmatic mercenary into a self-proclaimed prophet of the Earth Temple is a growing thread of self-deception, where his actions increasingly contradict his true nature, and others are beginning to notice.
source_quote: You're not a real cleric for the Earth Temple.

subject: Infernal Contract
fact: The salamander has offered a contract — unspoken but implied — that may bind the party to an unknown obligation in exchange for the treasure and its life, a pact whose terms remain hidden and whose consequences are yet to be revealed.
source_quote: And then it offered the thing I'd been waiting for without knowing it. A contract.

subject: Prophet Calmer
fact: Calmer has been turning the title 'Prophet Calmer' over in his mind all session.
source_quote: Chief Cleric. Loyal henchmen. Subordinate to Dren. The whole hierarchy laid out clean as a writ, and the commander nodding along like a man signing a confession he hasn't read. ... Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, *Prophet Calmer* —

subject: Prophet Calmer
fact: Calmer has been turning the title 'Prophet' over in his mind all session, considering its weight and potential, but has deferred its use until after establishing his chain of command — suggesting an impending elevation of his status.
source_quote: Chief Cleric is a fine thing to say ... and Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, Prophet Calmer.

subject: Salamander's intent
fact: The salamander knelt and set down its spear, but its true motive is unspecified and suspected to be calculated.
source_quote: It stopped. It knelt. It set its flaming spear down on the stone. ... I do not know what it is.

subject: St. Cuthbert's
fact: St. Cuthbert's is a name that is a death sentence in the Fire Temple.
source_quote: Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: St. Cuthbert's Name
fact: Frostbrand uttered the name St. Cuthbert’s in a temple where it is a death sentence — hinting at a forgotten holy war, a corrupted faith, or a hidden connection between elemental evil and divine justice.
source_quote: Named him for St. Cuthbert's, out loud, in a temple where that name is a death sentence.

subject: St. Cuthbert's teaching
fact: Calmer attributes the principle 'Authority abhors ambiguity' to St. Cuthbert, though he is unsure if he learned it from him or invented it in his name.
source_quote: Authority abhors ambiguity — St. Cuthbert taught me that, or I taught it to myself in his name, the line has gotten difficult to draw.

subject: Temple Ownership
fact: The narrator claims the Water Temple as their own — but Zinnia warns against overreaching into a room not yet owned, suggesting the temple’s full power and allegiance remain contested.
source_quote: Not to go too deep. To not overreach into a room I did not yet own.

subject: The Greater Temple
fact: The salamander holds secrets about what is truly happening beneath the elemental temples — a hidden power structure that the party must now pursue, making this alliance the first thread in a larger conspiracy.
source_quote: It knows things. About the Greater Temple. About what is actually happening beneath all of this.

subject: The Meaning of Surrender
fact: A deeper thread emerges: surrender is no longer a battlefield outcome, but a psychological ritual — two coins, a name spoken, a title accepted — and those who perform it best now rule.
source_quote: The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything." / "I will not forget this." / "Nor will I.

subject: Titles vs. Power
fact: The party is engaged in an ongoing ritual of title-building — Chief Cleric, Supreme Commander, Prophet Calmer — not for legitimacy, but to cement psychological control over conquered foes and allies alike, revealing that names now outweigh deeds.
source_quote: Chief Cleric is a fine thing to say... Prophet would be finer still — I had been turning the word over all session, the weight of it, *Prophet Calmer*.

subject: Water Temple Ambush
fact: The next target — the Water Temple — has been identified, and the party is preparing to move into its submerged domain, signaling the continuation of the Earth Temple’s campaign of absorption.
source_quote: So we went down into the sea that isn't a sea.

subject: Who is the Real Boss?
fact: A persistent thread runs through the party’s actions: the question of who truly holds authority — Zephyr, Calmer, or the collective — as each claims leadership through different means: ritual surrender, divine proclamation, or tactical dominance.
source_quote: I am the boss. Yes, I am." / "We had ourselves another retainer..." / "Zephyr isn't wrong.

subject: Zephyr's understanding
fact: Zephyr understood that the handing-over of coins meant more than their value, but the reason is unstated in this session.
source_quote: The coins meant nothing. The handing-over meant everything.
